pasystem-extensionname: Short name of the extension, shown on Special:Version.
pasystem-test: Name of the special page in menus.
pasystem-test-title: H1 title of the special page.
pasystem-test-intro: Introduction text of the test page.
pasystem-test-success: Confirmation message when the test succeeds.
pasystem-test-error: Failure message. $1 is the HTTP/network error.
pasystem-test-no-webhook: Error shown when no webhook is configured.
pasystem-test-message:
Content of the Discord test message (Discord markdown). Parameters:
* $1 - name of the user who triggered the test
* $2 - name of the wiki ($wgSitename)
pasystem-line-edit:
Full announcement line for a page edit (Discord markdown). Optional parameters may be empty; extra whitespace is collapsed automatically. Parameters:
* $1 - action icon (emoji, may be empty)
* $2 - markdown link to the user
* $3 - markdown link to the page
* $4 - byte delta, e.g. " `+123`" (includes leading space, may be empty)
* $5 - edit summary suffix (includes leading space, may be empty)
* $6 - diff link suffix (includes leading space, may be empty)
pasystem-line-new:
Full announcement line for a page creation (Discord markdown). Parameters:
* $1 - action icon (may be empty)
* $2 - markdown link to the user
* $3 - markdown link to the page
* $4 - byte delta (includes leading space, may be empty)
* $5 - summary suffix (includes leading space, may be empty)
pasystem-line-upload:
Full announcement line for a file upload. Parameters:
* $1 - action icon
* $2 - user link
* $3 - page link
* $4 - summary suffix (may be empty)
pasystem-line-delete: Full announcement line for a page deletion. Same parameters as {{msg-mw|pasystem-line-upload}}.
pasystem-line-restore: Full announcement line for a page restoration (undeletion). Same parameters as {{msg-mw|pasystem-line-upload}}.
pasystem-line-move:
Full announcement line for a page move. Parameters:
* $1 - action icon
* $2 - user link
* $3 - move description, see {{msg-mw|pasystem-line-move-arrow}}
* $4 - summary suffix (may be empty)
pasystem-line-move-arrow:
Describes a page move. Parameters:
* $1 - link to the old title
* $2 - link to the new title
pasystem-line-protect: Full announcement line for a page protection. Same parameters as {{msg-mw|pasystem-line-upload}}.
pasystem-line-unprotect: Full announcement line for a page unprotection. Same parameters as {{msg-mw|pasystem-line-upload}}.
pasystem-line-block:
Full announcement line for a user block. Parameters:
* $1 - action icon
* $2 - link to the blocking user
* $3 - blocked user name (inline code)
* $4 - summary suffix (may be empty)
pasystem-line-unblock: Full announcement line for a user unblock. Same parameters as {{msg-mw|pasystem-line-block}}.
pasystem-line-newuser:
Full announcement line for an account creation. Parameters:
* $1 - action icon
* $2 - link to the new user
pasystem-line-rights:
Full announcement line for a user rights change. Parameters:
* $1 - action icon
* $2 - link to the performing user
* $3 - link to the target user
* $4 - summary suffix (may be empty)
pasystem-line-log:
Generic announcement line for log actions without a dedicated template (patrol, import…). Parameters:
* $1 - action icon
* $2 - user link
* $3 - log type/action label (inline code, e.g. `patrol`)
* $4 - link to the target page
* $5 - summary suffix (may be empty)
pasystem-line-log-nopage:
Variant of {{msg-mw|pasystem-line-log}} for log entries without a target page. Parameters:
* $1 - action icon
* $2 - user link
* $3 - log type/action label
* $4 - summary suffix (may be empty)
pasystem-flood-notice: Single notice sent when the per-minute announcement cap ($wgPASystemMaxPerMinute) is crossed. $1 is the wiki name ($wgSitename).
pasystem-line-summary: Wrapper around the edit summary in line format. $1 is the (truncated, markdown-escaped) summary.
pasystem-line-diff: Wrapper around the diff link in line format. $1 is the markdown diff link labelled with {{msg-mw|pasystem-link-diff}}.
pasystem-embed-title:
Title of the Discord embed. Parameters:
* $1 - action icon
* $2 - user name
* $3 - action verb, one of the pasystem-action-* messages
* $4 - page title
pasystem-embed-title-newuser:
Title of the Discord embed for account creations. Parameters:
* $1 - action icon
* $2 - new user name
pasystem-embed-size: Name of the embed field showing the byte delta.
pasystem-embed-flags: Name of the embed field showing the m/b flags.
pasystem-embed-summary: Name of the embed field showing the edit summary.
pasystem-embed-links: Name of the embed field showing useful links.
pasystem-embed-footer: Footer text of the embed. $1 is the bot display name.
pasystem-action-edit: Action verb for page edits (used in the embed title, see {{msg-mw|pasystem-embed-title}}).
pasystem-action-rights: Action verb for user rights changes.
pasystem-action-log: Generic action verb for other log entries.
pasystem-link-diff:
Label of the link to the diff.
{{Identical|Diff}}
pasystem-link-page:
Label of the link to the page.
{{Identical|Page}}
pasystem-link-history:
Label of the link to the page history.
{{Identical|History}}
pasystem-link-contribs: Label of the link to the user's contributions.
pasystem-bytes-added: Embed size field value when bytes were added. $1 is the formatted number of bytes added (Discord markdown).
pasystem-bytes-removed: Embed size field value when bytes were removed. $1 is the formatted number of bytes removed (absolute value, Discord markdown).
pasystem-bytes-neutral: Embed size field value when the size did not change. $1 is 0, formatted.
